claims.claim_text: The platform praises President Bush's pursuit of a strategy through which the United States works with allies to confront emerging threats from any person or state before those threats fully materialize.

The platform praises President Bush's pursuit of a strategy through which the United States works with allies to improve capabilities to respond to weapons-of-mass-destruction use and minimize an attack's consequences.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States ended Saddam Hussein's decades-long pursuit of chemical, biological and nuclear weapons.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States achieved the elimination of Libya's weapons-of-mass-destruction and ballistic-missile programs.
Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States shut down the A.Q. Khan nuclear-proliferation network.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States led the Proliferation Security Initiative to interdict dangerous weapons of mass destruction and their means of delivery.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States strengthened efforts to secure weapons-usable materials and sensitive technologies in the former Soviet Union and elsewhere.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States insisted on confronting North Korea's threat through Six-Party Talks involving South Korea, Japan, China and Russia.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States supported International Atomic Energy Agency work to hold Iran's regime to its treaty obligations.
Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States strengthened international nonproliferation export-control and treaty regimes.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States secured unanimous passage of United Nations Security Council Resolution 1540, requiring states to criminalize proliferation activities.

Over the preceding two years, under President Bush's leadership and working with like-minded nations, the United States achieved G-8 agreement to refrain for one year from initiating new transfers of uranium-enrichment and reprocessing technology to additional states.
